caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rooster silhouette painted in a faded, muted red color. The rooster is stylized with simple, clean-cut lines for its body, beak, comb, and tail feathers. The rooster is mounted on a cylindrical base that appears to be a section of a wooden post or column, also colored in reddish-brown tones with visible wood grain texture. The silhouette is attached to the post by a hinge at the bottom, suggesting it may function as a weather vane or similar ornament. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery. The overall composition centers the rooster and base against the empty background, emphasizing the form and color of the objects.
title: Weather Vane
